_doc: AC07 (Пункт редуцирования газа 2) VPM texture sets, KPP1 recipe of the AC08 pilot (#559, PR #574). Colour only: geometry, topology, UCX and IDs from the source (max-dump-007.json). Colour authority = presentation «ТЭЦ26 на РР (1).pptx» slides 44 (А-Д, Д-А) and 45 (1-3, 3-1) (Artem 2026-10-22 16:1x, supersedes DWG-based colour decisions): walls light grey RAL 7047 with vertical ribs over the full height, band above +2.500, roof, eaves and canopies blue RAL 5015 (band ribbed), plinth/footing/downpipes dark grey RAL 7004, round vents dark. Gate 1 (#564 «Принимаю») where the slides are silent. Rib COUNT per facade measured on the same «Фасад ... Цветовое решение» drawing in 22Е56-АР2-1002-АС.07_R1.dwg (ac07.dxf): one rib every 200 mm, 55 ribs short / 68 long, and on the slide images (compare). Panels: Artem's vertical-joint texture (colour/noise/look of one joint), grey below +2.500 and blue above in ONE tile per facade pair (lower_band, v = world z), KPP VPM texel 1000 px/m. No frame posts on this building (no AC08-style frame band). Address Prg_2 is a placeholder token.

facades_doc: Rib contract from 22Е56-АР2-1002-АС.07_R1.dwg (AutoCAD readback ac07.dxf, model space, titles #105135 А-Д, #105134 Д-А, #104EB0 1-3, #104EB2 3-1 «Фасад ... Цветовое решение»): vertical joint lines (layer PDF_Чертеж.АР) every 200 mm across the whole 10900 / 13500 mm wall from +0.120 to the eaves - А-Д at 100+200k (54 lines), Д-А at 200+200k (54), 1-3 at 100+200k (67), 3-1 at 200+200k (67); ribs = joints + 1 = 55 / 68. Lines of downpipes (115/237 mm) and window frames excluded. Model wall (ID3 faces of max-dump-007) = 10.9 / 13.5 m; P = field_m / ribs = 0.19818 / 0.19853 m, joints at field_lo + k P (even and symmetric, as accepted on the AC08 pilot). Facade names: -x = А-Д (round inserts ID6), +x = Д-А, -y = 3-1 (pressure-relief windows), +y = 1-3.
